pages.text: Daisy loved her beautiful meadow home. But one morning, she noticed something wrong. Some of her flower friends looked droopy and sad!
"What's wrong, little flower?" Daisy asked gently. She looked closely. Some flowers were in bright sunshine. Some were in cool shade. Some had wet soil. Some had dry soil.
Daisy had an idea! "Maybe different flowers need different things," she thought. She placed her flower carefully in the shade of the tree. "Let's try this!"
The flower in the shade perked up! "You needed to be cooler!" Daisy said happily. "But I wonder... would some water help you even more?"
Daisy filled a watering can with water and carefully carried it back. She let drops fall gently on the soil. Slowly, the flower stood up tall and bright!

Daisy smiled at her healthy flower friend. "Now I understand! Every flower needs something special - some need shade, some need sun, some need water. I can help them all grow!" And she did, every day.
Daisy put on her gardening apron and got her vegetable seeds ready. "Today I'm going to grow my very own garden!" she said excitedly. She had seeds for carrots, tomatoes, and lettuce!
First, Daisy prepared the soil. She dug small holes and made the earth soft and ready. "Good soil helps seeds grow strong," she said.
Daisy carefully planted each tiny seed. She dropped in a seed into each hole, and covered it gently with soil. "Sleep well, little seeds," she whispered.
Every morning, Daisy watered her garden with her watering can. She watched and waited patiently. "Growing takes time," she reminded herself.
One day, tiny green sprouts poked through the soil! "You're growing!" Daisy cheered. She kept watering and caring for them each day. The sprouts grew taller and taller.

Soon, beautiful vegetables grew everywhere! Orange carrots, red tomatoes, and round lettuce filled her garden. Daisy smiled proudly. "I grew all of this from tiny seeds! With patience and care, anything can grow!"
Daisy's vegetable garden was growing beautifully! But she noticed something curious. Friendly bees kept buzzing from plant to plant. "What are you doing, little bees?" she wondered.
Daisy watched closely. The bees landed on her tomato flowers and wiggled around. When they flew away, yellow pollen dust stuck to their fuzzy bodies!
The bees flew to another tomato flower. The pollen from their fuzzy bodies brushed onto the new flower. "Oh!" said Daisy. "You're moving the pollen!"
Daisy remembered - her flowers needed pollen to grow into vegetables! "The bees are helping my garden grow!" she realized. "That's why they visit so many flowers."
Daisy wanted to thank the bees. She planted extra flowers around her vegetable garden - flowers full of sweet nectar for the bees to enjoy.
Now bees buzzed happily between the vegetables and flowers. Daisy smiled. "We help each other! The bees help my vegetables grow, and my flowers help feed the bees. We're a team!"
